import sys, time, itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from syntax import parse_policy
from compiler.compiler import compile_policy
def build(words, names):
    pol = 'startswith() allow;' + ''.join('match(%s) drop;' % ','.join(w) for w in words)
    order = names; idx = {n:i for i,n in enumerate(order)}
    rules,a,p = parse_policy(pol)
    t=time.time(); acc, rows, cells = compile_policy(rules, order, idx)
    return len(rows), cells, round(time.time()-t,3), a, p
print('small:', build([(), ('A',), ('B',), ('A','B')], ['A','B']))
names = ['S%d'%i for i in range(16)]
